metadata.description: The nested case. dist/packages/llm is ONE npm package with 8 entry points (root, /decision, /craft, /openai, /openrouter, /zenmux, /node, /test), not 6 packages: /decision and /craft are rollup inputs of THIS project, and llm-openai / llm-openrouter / llm-zenmux / llm-node / llm-test compile INTO this directory and are named by this package's own dist `exports`. So this target is the sole deliverable and the sole owner of the directory, and the children deliberately have no `build` of their own. The finalize stays this target's own command, so it runs after every entry point is built -- dependsOn does not order its own entries.

`^build`, NOT the `^build-base` @nx/rollup/plugin infers. @nx/js remaps @dereekb/* imports to the dist DIRECTORY, so TypeScript reads that directory's package.json `exports` to resolve them -- and rollup writes `.` as {import, types} until that dependency's own `build` reorders it. `^build-base` would compile this package against un-finalized dependencies.
